title: A Gift from the Monks
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW A Gift from the Monks.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Monk]] |location= Ancient Shrine |prereq= Complete 120 [[Ancient Shrine]]s |reward= {{Icon List|BotW| * Cap of the Wild * Tunic of the Wild * Trousers of the Wild }} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|A Gift from the Monks||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|A Gift from the Monks}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Ancient Shrine}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== After [[Link]] completes the last of the 120 [[Ancient Shrine]]s, the final [[Monk]] will tell him that they have prepared something for a true hero.{{Cite|You have at last conquered all of our trials. Having fulfilled our purpose, we monks bestow upon you this... The warrant of a true hero.|Monk|BotW}}{{Note|The Ancient Shrines added in {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack do not count towards this total.}} Link is instructed to go to the [[Forgotten Temple]],{{Cite|You must now depart for the Forgotten Temple.|Monk|BotW}} which activates the [[Side Quest]]. Like all other Monks, this Monk will wish Link well before fading away.{{Cite|May the Goddess smile upon you.|Monk|BotW}} As Link has already finished all 120 Ancient Shrines, he will be able to [[Warping|Warp]] directly to [[Rona Kachta Shrine]] inside the Forgotten Temple. Three [[Stone Chest]]s will appear below the [[Mother Goddess Statue]] inside, which contain the [[Cap of the Wild]], the [[Tunic of the Wild]], and the [[Trousers of the Wild]]. Once Link has collected all three pieces of [[Armor]], the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You've conquered all of the shrine trials. The monks have prepared a gift for just such an occasion.

Head to the Forgotten Temple where the oldest statue of the Goddess stands to see what they have left for you there. |- | Complete | You've accepted the gift from the monks at the Forgotten Temple.

Inside, you found a special green outfit made especially for the hero who braved the wilderness alone.

Will donning this outfit help you to become the land's true hero? }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW 120th Shrine Completion Monk Dialogue 1.png|A Monk guiding Link to his reward File:BotW 120th Shrine Completion Monk Dialogue 2.png|A Monk guiding Link to his reward File:BotW 120th Shrine Completion Monk Dialogue 3.png|A Monk guiding Link to his reward ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Shrine * Monk * Of the Wild Set * Tanagar Canyon Temple }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
